set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/$(id -u)"
export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bus"
systemctl --user stop gace-userbot-verify.service
trap 'systemctl --user start gace-userbot-verify.service || true' EXIT
cd "$root"
deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import asyncio,sys
from telethon import TelegramClient
from scripts.userbot_session import load_credentials,SESSION_BASE
async def main():
    a,h=load_credentials()
    async with TelegramClient(str(SESSION_BASE),a,h) as c:
        if not await c.is_user_authorized():raise SystemExit(81)
        n=0
        async for d in c.iter_dialogs(limit=100):
            if d.is_group and any(w in (d.name or "") for w in ("エリア","ビデオChat","ゲイのための掲示板")):n+=1
        if n==0:raise SystemExit(82)
        print("USERBOT_BOARD_MEMBERSHIP_PASS")
try:asyncio.run(main())
except SystemExit:raise
except Exception as e:
    print("DIALOG_SCAN_EXCEPTION="+type(e).__name__)
    sys.exit(83)
PY
echo USERBOT_DIALOG_SCAN_PASS
